metadata.title: Q15. Người Gác Thư Viện – Boss
metadata.scale: Khung trận 768 px, quay sang trái. Ngoài map 48×48 px. Cao khoảng 6,0 m so với nhân vật phe ta 2,0 m (để đặt tỉ lệ trong khung).
phases: - GĐ1: áo giấy kín, sách xoay đều, màu sáng

revisions.prompt: Redraw this exact monster as a TRUE 90-degree orthographic LEFT SIDE PROFILE turnaround. Camera is exactly perpendicular to the creature's side. Change its pose and orientation substantially from the reference. Show ONLY its LEFT side; the front/chest/face must NOT face the viewer. One visible eye (if eyes), overlapping far limbs, nose/muzzle pointing horizontally LEFT, chest in profile. Lower weapons into resting position. For winged creatures only one side wing silhouette, wings partially folded. For the mechanical furnace arm show a horizontal arm in exact side elevation, wall edge-on at RIGHT. For the flying book show narrow thickness/spine in side profile with one folded wing, do NOT show the broad front cover. Keep same identity, anatomy, costume details and colors. Single full body with all appendages visible, plain white background, crisp cel-shaded game concept, no text, no duplicate or sheet. For humanoids draw the face entirely in profile with ONE eye visible and NO front view of face/chest. For the cargo beast draw its spine horizontal and the entire animal in exact left side elevation with ONE tusk silhouette and ONE visible eye, legs overlapping their opposite partners.
